reviews.title: Scam Eventually
reviews.text:
I had cashwalk for many years and have gotten some gift cards from them. Then suddenly I got an error message saying they “don’t pay for service outside of the country.” Just like that, my hard earned points can’t be claimed. I closed the account and opened a new account with a new email address. 

With the new account, when I tried to redeem at 5,000 points, I got the same error message AGAIN. I emailed their customer support directly from the app and got a response quickly from Korea saying that I need to redeem at 10,000 points. When I finally got 10k points and tried to redeem it, I got the same error AGAIN. I contacted their customer support and again, the response was from Korea that basically reiterated the error message. Waste of my time. I deleted my account and the Cashwalk app for good. 

If you have points, redeem it ASAP because one day, you will get the error message I got and you will not be able to redeem. Go ahead and AI or google this, there are many people out there reporting the same problem and can’t redeem their points.

reviews.title: It works!
reviews.text:
I’ve been using CashWalk for years. I do have some pros and cons for it. The pros is that once a user reaches the 10k coin min threshold, they can cash out their coins for a gift card. Also, the app is very user friendly and straightforward. 

Now the cons. After a year of coins not being redeemed, CashWalk removes 1k at a time. That’s not fair for a person who takes a year to build up 10k coins. Then it would take them longer. The next con is that the step counter is not that accurate. I can leave my phone in my pocket and purposely walk and it would not count steps. The last con is that a user has to play games in order to build their coin balance so they can redeem faster. 

I’m pleased with this app overall but take the cons into consideration to prevent user frustration. Thank you!

I do not recommend this app.
I have been using CashWalk for several years, and I have experienced the same serious issue multiple times. I spend a long time accumulating coins, and when my balance gets close to 9,600 coins, suddenly thousands of coins disappear overnight and my balance drops to around 1,000.This has happened to me more than once. I contacted customer support several times, but the only response I received was basically an apology. My missing coins were never restored and the problem was never resolved.It is extremely frustrating to spend months collecting coins with the expectation of redeeming a reward, only to have most of them disappear when you are getting close to the redemption amount.
Based on my repeated experience and the lack of a real solution from customer support, I cannot recommend CashWalk.
